descriptions.value: A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authorization on the CDP Coordinator Service.

Memory corruption in PictureInPicture in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.47 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

A vulnerability in the CLI command handling of the AOS-8 web interface could allow an authenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to run unauthorized commands on the system, potentially leading to system compromise.

assertions.title: Improper Sanitization leads to Command Injection in AOS-8 Web Interface

descriptions.description: CWE-77 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

title: Improper Sanitization leads to Command Injection in AOS-8 Web Interface

descriptions.value: The Pie Register  WordPress plugin before 3.8.4.14 does not restrict access to an invitation-code report, allowing unauthenticated visitors who know a valid invitation code to obtain the username and email address of every user who registered with that code.

assertions.title: Pie Register < 3.8.4.14 - Unauthenticated User Email Disclosure via Invitation Code

descriptions.description: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: Pie Register < 3.8.4.14 - Unauthenticated User Email Disclosure via Invitation Code
